items.abstract: FAA는 특정 De Havilland Aircraft of Canada Limited(Bombardier, Inc.가 이전에 보유한 형식 인증서) 모델 DHC-8-401 및 DHC-8-402 항공기에 대해 새로운 감항성 지침(AD)을 채택할 것을 제안합니다. 이 제안된 AD는 탱크 리브의 내부 표면에 설치된 브래킷에 대해 페이, 필렛 및 리벳 돔 밀봉에 대한 지침이 생략되었다는 보고에 의해 촉발되었습니다.
items.abstract_en: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain De Havilland Aircraft of Canada Limited (Type Certificate Previously Held by Bombardier, Inc.) Model DHC-8-401 and DHC-8-402 airplanes. This proposed AD was prompted by a report that instructions for fay, fillet, and rivet dome sealing were omitted for a bracket installed on the inboard surface of the tank rib, which could allow fuel to leak from the wing fuel tank into the wing dry bay. This proposed AD would require a detailed visual inspection of the affected bracket assembly for signs of fuel leakage and for the presence of fillet seal and fastener dome seal, and applicable on-condition actions. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

Entry of vessels or persons into this zone is prohibited unless specifically authorized by the Captain of the Port, Port Arthur, or their designated representative.

items.abstract_en: The FAA is adopting a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain Pilatus Aircraft Ltd. (Pilatus) Model PC-24 airplanes. This AD was prompted by a report that a solid-state relay (SSR) used in the left-hand (LH) windshield heating system may allow reverse current flow when in the OFF position. This AD requires modification of the airplane and replacement of the affected SSR with a serviceable part. The FAA is issuing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

items.abstract: FAA는 소방관이 지상 산불 진압을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 것이 운송의 목적인 경우 소방관을 특정 제한 범주 항공기에 탑승하여 산불 현장으로 이동하는 것을 허용하는 향후 규정 개정안을 평가하고 있습니다. 개정안은 제한된 범주가 적용되는 경우 민간 항공기 운항 및 공공 항공기 운항에 적용됩니다.
items.abstract_en: FAA is evaluating a future amendment to its regulations to permit firefighters to be transported to and from the site of a wildfire aboard certain restricted category aircraft when the purpose of that transportation is to permit those firefighters to perform ground wildfire suppression. The amendment would apply to civil aircraft operations and public aircraft operations when the restricted category aircraft is owned by a civilian operator. This action responds to a statutory mandate, and FAA has determined it needs additional information to address both the mandate and the assessment of its economic impact. This ANPRM invites public comments on the current availability of firefighter transportation resources, hindrances and needs influencing their transport, and cost-benefit consideration

items.title_en: Sport Pilot Practical Test Standards Alignment
items.abstract: FAA는 항공병 자격증에 적용되는 특정 규정을 개정하고 업데이트된 세 가지 스포츠 조종사 실기 시험 표준(PTS)을 참조로 통합합니다. 이 규칙은 스포츠 조종사 인증 및 경량 스포츠 카테고리 운영과 관련된 특수 감항성 인증 현대화(MOSAIC) 최종 규칙에서 새로 채택된 규제 요구 사항과 항공병 테스트 표준을 일치시킵니다.
items.abstract_en: FAA revises certain regulations governing airman certification and incorporates three updated sport pilot practical test standards (PTS) by reference. The rule aligns the airman testing standards with newly adopted regulatory requirements in the Modernization of Special Airworthiness Certification (MOSAIC) final rule related to the certification of sport pilots and operation of light-sport category aircraft and updates the PTS to improve airman certification standard materials.
